subject: Customer-led k6 simulation: concurrency slots & streaming replay next steps
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: ops+qa@velocity.ai, sre-team@velocity.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap & next steps — customer-led k6 simulation

Hi Jamal / Velocity QA team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to see the test plan coming together. Quick recap from our side and a short list of concrete next steps so we can get the rehearsal scheduled: 

Summary of SLO/targets we discussed (please confirm these back if anything below is off):
- P95 tail latency target for short responses (<= 512 tokens): 150 ms
- Sustained throughput target during warm windows: 120 requests/sec (api-gen endpoints)
- Concurrency target: 50 concurrent request slots over repeated 10-minute windows; goal is to validate autoscaler behavior under steady bursts
- Streaming sessions: support 20 concurrent streaming sessions for ~5–7 minutes each with average chunk latency < 50 ms

What we need from Velocity to start the customer-led run:
1) Candidate test windows (2 options, UTC preferred) — we tentatively proposed Jun 21 14:00 UTC or Jun 23 02:00 UTC.
2) k6 script(s) and any parameterization you want us to preserve (we agreed on a single scenario for initial run + a ramp profile)
3) IP allowlist entries (we’ll provide a static egress IP range; you can also give us a firewall CIDR to add on your side)
4) Test account / API key for a non-prod seat (scoped to the test namespace); please confirm required scopes

Attachments: initial-runbook.pdf (high-level runbook, traffic matrix, rollback checklist).

Immediate asks for Redwood ops: Ben/Marissa — can you provision a short-lived test service account scoped to the Velocity test namespace and generate a one-off API key once Jamal confirms the account name? Also can you confirm the static egress IP range we should share?

Next step: Jamal — if you can reply to confirm the window and attach the k6 script, we’ll lock the slot and run a quick smoke today from our staging fleet.

Thanks — Rachel

--
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
https://redwood.ai

From: ops+qa@velocity.ai <ops+qa@velocity.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: sre-team@velocity.ai (Jamal Ortiz)
Date: 2028-06-16T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — customer-led k6 simulation

Thanks Rachel — quick confirm from Velocity QA.

We can take the Jun 23 02:00 UTC window (preferred) or Jun 21 14:00 UTC as fallback. Jamal (SRE) will be on the call and will observe the streaming behavior and autoscaler metrics.

Attached is our initial k6 script (velocity_k6_v1.js) — please do not change the payload shapes; we will parameterize VUs and stages. For the run we intend to:
- ramp to 50 concurrent over 7 minutes
- hold 10 minutes at target throughput
- perform a 3-minute sustained spike to 120 req/s to validate queueing/fallback

For IP allowlist: please send the egress IPs to allowlist@velocity.ai.

Test account: create a non-prod API key with read/write to the test-namespace ‘vel-test-2028’. Please mark it with the description: "Velocity k6 rehearsal - ephemeral" and email creds to ops+qa@velocity.ai. Jamal will coordinate.

We’ve attached the k6 script and included a short note inline when we made a small change to the chunking logic in comments.

— Velocity QA (on behalf of Jamal Ortiz)
attachments: velocity_k6_v1.js

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-16T12:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — customer-led k6 simulation

Looping in ops runbook items. Thanks Jamal for the details. Action items I’ll take: 

- Provision service account: service-account name = velocity-load@redwood.ai (ephemeral; TTL 72h)
- Generate API key scoped to test-namespace vel-test-2028 and email to ops+qa@velocity.ai once we have confirmation of the account name
- Egress IPs: Confirming current static egress CIDR for the rehearsal fleet: 34.88.120.0/28 and 34.88.121.0/28 (these are the ranges we use for dedicated warm pools). If Velocity prefers a single IP, we can also NAT to 34.88.120.14 for the rehearsal window — let me know.

Marissa — can you stage the runbook snippet for autoscaler thresholds (CPU/queue depth hooks) in the shared Drive folder and add a short smoke checklist? Link to folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2B3k6-runbooks/velocity-k6

I’m attaching the onboarding doc I used for the last partner run (service-account-onboarding.md) so Jamal has the steps for how we issue the keys.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 510-555-0147

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: ops+qa@velocity.ai, sre-team@velocity.ai (Jamal Ortiz)
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-17T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Confirmed rehearsal window + artifacts (Jun 23 02:00 UTC)

Thanks everyone — quick final confirmation after Ben’s set up: 

Confirmed:
- Rehearsal window: Jun 23, 2028 02:00 UTC (2-hour block for run + warmup + post-mortem)
- Test account: velocity-load (velocity-load@redwood.ai) TTL 72h; Ben will email the API key to ops+qa@velocity.ai after they confirm the namespace name
- Egress IPs: 34.88.120.0/28; Jamal please accept the /28 on your firewall or request NAT to 34.88.120.14 if you need single-IP entry
- k6 script received: velocity_k6_v1.js (thanks)
- Attachments and links: initial-runbook.pdf (run steps), velocity_k6_v1.js (script), service-account-onboarding.md (how we’ll hand off keys), runbook folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2B3k6-runbooks/velocity-k6

On-call & escalation: Tara (redwood-sre@redwood.ai) will be on-call for autoscaler alerts; Jamal will handle Velocity-side incident triage. If we see sustained P95 > 300 ms we will trigger rollback to the smaller-variant model and abort the rehearsal.

Next step for Velocity: confirm the namespace name and we’ll send the API key. I’ll also schedule a 15-minute pre-run sync 30 minutes before the window to validate connectivity.

Best — Rachel

--
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
attachments: initial-runbook.pdf, velocity_k6_v1.js, service-account-onboarding.md
